text: {"lessons":["My account fell sharply in one month and later recovered while I made no trades; I should not judge a strategy by one month's account-value change.","A lower share price alone is not evidence that a stock is a bargain; I should know what would make me buy and what would change my mind.","Because I hope to buy an apartment within ten years, I should keep money needed for that goal on a timeline and risk level that can withstand market downturns."]}
